LynxViewElement.example.0.en:
HTML Example

Note that you should declarae the size of lynx-view

```html
<lynx-view url="https://path/to/main-thread.js" raw-data="{}" global-props="{}" style="height:300px;width:300px">
</lynx-view>
```

React 19 Example
```jsx
<lynx-view url={myLynxCardUrl} rawData={{}} globalProps={{}} style={{height:'300px', width:'300px'}}>
</lynx-view>
```
LynxViewElement.example.0.text:
HTML 示例

注意，你需要声明 lynx-view 的尺寸

```html
<lynx-view url="https://path/to/main-thread.js" raw-data="{}" global-props="{}" style="height:300px;width:300px">
</lynx-view>
```

React 19 示例

```jsx
<lynx-view url={myLynxCardUrl} rawData={{}} globalProps={{}} style={{height:'300px', width:'300px'}}>
</lynx-view>
```

LynxViewElement.injectStyleRules.summary.en: [optional] the css rules which will be injected into shadowroot. Each items will be inserted by `insertRule` method.
LynxViewElement.injectStyleRules.summary.text: [可选] 将被注入到 shadowroot 中的 CSS 规则。每一项都会通过 `insertRule` 方法插入。

LynxViewElement.napiModulesMap.summary.en: [optional] the napiModule which is called in lynx-core. key is module-name, value is esm url.
LynxViewElement.napiModulesMap.summary.text: [可选] 在 lynx-core 中调用的 napiModule。key 为模块名，value 为 ESM URL。

LynxViewElement.nativeModulesMap.summary.en:
[optional] use to customize NativeModules. key is module-name, value is esm url.
A `LynxConsoleModule` whose factory returns a Console-like object provides
the lexical `console` for this view's background bundles.
LynxViewElement.nativeModulesMap.summary.text:
[可选] 用于自定义 NativeModules。key 为模块名，value 为 ESM URL。
若某个 `LynxConsoleModule` 的工厂函数返回类 Console 对象，它将
为此 view 的后台 bundle 提供词法作用域中的 `console`。

LynxViewElement.onNapiModulesCall.summar.text: [可选] NapiModule 的值处理函数。

LynxViewElement.globalProps.summary.en: [optional] (attribute: "global-props") The globalProps value of this Lynx card
LynxViewElement.globalProps.summary.text: [可选]（属性："global-props"）此 Lynx 卡片的 globalProps 值

LynxViewElement.initData.summary.en: [optional] (attribute: "init-data") The initial data of this Lynx card
LynxViewElement.initData.summary.text: [可选]（属性："init-data"）此 Lynx 卡片的初始数据

LynxViewElement.initI18nResources.summar.en: [optional] (attribute: "init-i18n-resources") the complete set of i18nResources that on the container side, which can be obtained synchronously by _I18nResourceTranslation
LynxViewElement.initI18nResources.summar.text: [可选]（属性："init-i18n-resources"）容器侧完整的 i18nResources 集合，可通过 _I18nResourceTranslation 同步获取

LynxViewElement.lynxGroupId.summary.en: [optional] (attribute: "lynx-group-id") the background shared context id, which is used to share webworker between different lynx cards
LynxViewElement.lynxGroupId.summary.text: [可选]（属性："lynx-group-id"）后台共享上下文 id，用于在不同 Lynx 卡片之间共享 webworker

LynxViewElement.onNativeModulesCall.summ.en: [optional] the NativeModules value handler. Arguments will be cached before this property is assigned.
LynxViewElement.onNativeModulesCall.summ.text: [可选] NativeModules 的值处理函数。在该属性被赋值之前，调用参数会被缓存。

LynxViewElement.url.summary.en: [required] (attribute: "url") The url of the entry of your Lynx card
LynxViewElement.url.summary.text: [必填]（属性："url"）Lynx 卡片入口的 URL

WebComponentClass.notToFilterFalseAttrib.text:
对于 attribute="false"，
默认会执行 removeAttribute；
在此处设置可禁用该行为；
